Accélérer la transition énergétique en équipant les particuliers de panneaux solaires, batteries de stockage et bornes de recharge. Lancée il y a seulement trois ans, OESF compte déjà plus de 50 collaborateurs et une équipe commerciale d'une vingtaine de personnes répartie entre Paris et Lille. Et ce n'est que le début ! Nous sommes en pleine phase de scale-up avec de fortes ambitions de croissance. Pour accompagner cette accélération, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Sales Team Leader pour piloter notre équipe commerciale à Paris ! Ta mission : emmener ton équipe vers la performance ! Tu prends la responsabilité d'une équipe de 7 Business Developers sédentaires qui commercialisent nos solutions par téléphone et visioconférence, du premier contact jusqu'à la signature. Ton objectif ? Fédérer ton équipe, faire progresser chaque commercial(e) et atteindre les objectifs de ventes ! Tu es un·e manager de proximité qui allie coaching, exigence et bienveillance. Tu travailleras en étroite collaboration avec le Sales Team Leader de Lille, les technico-commerciaux terrain et notre Bureau d'Études. Tes missions seront les suivantes :

jobs.title: Senior Financial Accountant H/F
jobs.description_text: Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech. Comment on fait ? On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer. On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques. Pourquoi ce poste ? Octopus Energy France connaît une forte croissance sur ses segments B2C, B2B et B2G, et sa fonction Finance se structure en parallèle : migration récente d’Odoo vers NetSuite, automatisation de la chaîne fournisseurs, interfaçage avec les plateformes de facturation, harmonisation avec les standards du groupe au Royaume-Uni. Nous cherchons un·e comptable senior capable de prendre en main un périmètre critique (marge brute et fiscalité énergie), de le fiabiliser et de le faire évoluer. Plus qu’un·e exécutant·e, tu seras celui ou celle qui identifie les problèmes, en comprend la cause et met en place des solutions durables.

jobs.description_text: Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. jobs.title: Affiliate Athletic Trainer
jobs.description_text: DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW: The Boston Red Sox Medical team is dedicated to providing our players with the highest level of sports medicine care in professional baseball, maximizing short- and long-term health and performance within the organization’s philosophies and processes. We integrate every area of the medical team with adjacent performance departments to reduce injury and illness rates, deliver precise and timely evaluation and treatment, and build long-term strategies that educate players and staff on health and performance best practices. POSITION OVERVIEW: The Boston Red Sox are seeking two Minor League Athletic Trainers to join our Athletic Training staff. Successful candidates will be placed at one of our minor league affiliates based on experience and organizational needs and will work under the direct supervision of the Minor League Athletic Training Coordinator and Head Minor League Team Physician. This is a year-round salaried position, with responsibilities included but not limited to spring training, the affiliated championship season, off-season player check-ins, and fall performance programs. Selected candidates will have access to the Boston Red Sox’s internal orthopedic and manual therapy education platform. They will also gain hands-on experience as part of a professional sports medicine team, with opportunities to work alongside the Major League staff during Spring Training.

jobs.title: Development Coach - Dominican Republic Academy
jobs.description_text: DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW: The Player Development department is dedicated to fostering the comprehensive growth of our minor league players. Our mission is to excel in optimizing talent and skill development while aligning with player and team objectives. Our approach involves the creation of world class player programs and efficiently scaling them across our player pool. Collaborating closely with baseball analytics, performance, and medical, we establish effective frameworks for experimentation and learning. Additionally, we work closely with Amateur Scouting, International Scouting, and Pro Scouting to ensure seamless player transitions into the Red Sox organization. POSITION OVERVIEW : The Academy Development Coach will support player development at the Dominican Republic Academy by operating baseball technology, ensuring reliable data collection, and helping translate performance information into actionable development priorities. Working closely with Academy Staff, Roving Coordinators, and Baseball Analytics, this role will help monitor progress toward individual player development goals. The ideal candidate communicates effectively in English and Spanish, is comfortable working with data and technology, and builds strong relationships with players and staff. The position also provides opportunities to participate in on-field instruction and develop coaching skills.

jobs.title: Director, Global B2B TPM
jobs.description_text:
Global B2B is Lyft's cross-organizational mandate to build one platform, one product vision, and one integrated plan across every line of business that runs on B2B revenue: US B2B, EU B2B, EU B2G, Chauffeur, AVs, Bikes, and Partner/Protocol integrations. As Lyft has grown internationally through acquisitions like FreeNow, Gett, and TBR, the technology, P&Ls, and org charts have continued to run as separate regional stacks. Global B2B exists to change that: to build a common platform that compounds instead of resetting with every new deal, powering existing US demand while unlocking the lines of business we've had to turn away.

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager who can bring order, rigor, and momentum to a program of this scale: one that spans multiple P&Ls, multiple geographies, and multiple functions, all moving toward one plan. You'll report directly to Rishi Dean (VP of Technology and DRI of Global B2B) and will be the connective tissue that turns strategy into a sequenced, tracked, and delivered program. You're technically strong, comfortable operating in ambiguity, and skilled at getting people who don't report to you to move together toward a shared date.

RESPONSIBILITIES

jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE: Xsolla is an international IT company that offers a number of services for video games. We create solutions for developers that help to integrate payments, attract users, and publish games all over the world. We also provide round-the-clock technical support. We are trusted by such giants as Twitch, Valve, Epic Games, Take2 and many more. As a Business Development Manager at Xsolla you will be responsible for researching, understanding, and selling Xsolla's products and solutions to clients in Global. Your primary functions will be sourcing and building new partnerships with individuals in the video game community and closing deals. Since this role is connected to the company strategy you will be able to influence decisions on a global level and the director role.

jobs.title: Partner Success Manager, China & APAC
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Partner Success Manager to join the Xsolla Partner Network (XPN) Business Development team, based in China. This is a newly created, hybrid role sitting within the core XPN BD team — roughly 80% campaign and partner success, 20% business development support — created to close a gap in how XPN partners are supported once a deal closes: campaigns are launched, but no one consistently owns their ongoing success. The best candidate will be someone comfortable owning outcomes rather than just relationships — proactively strategizing with partners, coordinating across internal teams to get campaigns right, and stepping in to help close deals when local presence and trust matter more than a remote pitch. Full ownership of the sales process (sourcing, pitching, commercial negotiation) sits with the Core China/APAC Team; this role isn't required to run a deal end-to-end, but is expected to help get opportunities over the line and make sure they deliver once signed. If you're excited about building a new function from the ground up, becoming a product expert partners and internal teams rely on, and working across both Chinese and global creator platforms as publishers look to expand their reach, we would love to hear from you! jobs.title: Team Lead
jobs.description_text: ABOUT US Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game. For more information, visit xsolla.com. THE ROLE We are hiring a Team Lead, Web3 to lead a cross-functional team of frontend, backend, smart contract and QA engineers in XsollaZK, Xsolla's Web3 ecosystem on a zkSync-based L2. Your team builds: smart wallets built on account abstraction; SDKs that game studios and partners use to bring players on-chain; infrastructure backend services for tokenizing in-game items and currencies; ecosystem dApps: a DEX, an NFT marketplace and an auction. This is a management role. Most of your time goes to people and delivery: building the team, growing engineers, and making delivery predictable. The rest goes to technical leadership: architecture, reviews and hands-on code where it matters.

jobs.title: Manager, Revenue and Receivables
jobs.description_text: Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years. Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators. Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world. The company’s state-of-the-art Satellite fleet consists of 12 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat-1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite. For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Manager, Revenue and Receivables is responsible for overseeing the revenue accounting and billing functions for Telesat and its subsidiaries, credit and collections for the Consolidated group of companies, and implementation and maintenance of revenue reporting and related controls.

The Senior Manager, PMO has a staff who serve as the central integrators across engineering, operations, supply chain, finance, mission assurance, product management, and other stakeholder organizations supporting multiple projects. The position does not directly manage segment Program Managers, who remain within their respective organizations and coordinate extensively with the PMO, However, the role establishes program management standards, methodologies, reporting requirements, and governance practices across the enterprise. The successful candidate must be comfortable operating in an evolving environment where not all processes, standards, and organizational interfaces have been fully established, and where success requires building structure, alignment, and operational discipline across multiple stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist - Behavior AI
jobs.description_text:
The Behavior AI team builds the AI-based anomaly detection behind Datadog's security products. Our models learn what normal looks like across the billions of logs, events, and telemetry records flowing through the platform every second, and they flag the behavior that does not fit, on every record, in real time, at a cost that makes sense at our scale. What we build does not ship to a single feature. The same models power detection across many of Datadog's security products at once, so the work has impact well beyond any one team. Large general-purpose models are too slow and too expensive to run in that path, so we take the opposite approach: small, custom models, designed for high-throughput stream processing and optimized to run cheaply on every record.

 

We are hiring a Senior Applied Scientist to build these models from start to finish. You will contribute to designing the architecture, training at scale, and the optimization work that takes a model from training to running efficiently on production traffic. This optimization requires a deep understanding of the constraints imposed by both the software and the hardware, together with the applied mathematics to work within them: often it comes down to finding a mathematical reformulation that fits those constraints better, and that judgment can decide whether a model reaches production at all.

jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist - AI Platform
jobs.description_text:
AI Platform builds the foundations of Datadog's AI efforts. The org is 70+ people organised in three pillars: training and serving (GPU clusters, distributed training, low-level infrastructure), agents (agent harnesses, memory systems, the internal AI gateway that routes every LLM request at Datadog), and evaluation and experimentation. This role sits in the evaluation and experimentation pillar, which owns Datadog's shared annotation and evaluation infrastructure — including the evaluation scenario store and the telemetry archival systems used across the Bits org. Together they let an agent travel back in time and query what Datadog looked like at the exact moment an incident happened, so scenarios can be replayed and agent performance tracked over time.

Specifically, you'll be the first applied scientist on GenSim (Generative Simulations), the team that builds the environments Datadog's agents learn in. GenSim doesn't replay sampled telemetry — it stands up real, fully instrumented applications that talk to Datadog, drives them with representative traffic, injects controlled failures, and records what happens. Because GenSim injected the failure, it knows the ground truth. That corpus — hundreds of postmortem-derived scenarios and thousands of runnable applications — is today the primary source of post-training data for Datadog's own SRE model, and the substrate that Bits AI SRE and our other agents are trained and evaluated against.

jobs.description_text: Make sure every restaurant on SOUS grows its revenue, across Uber Eats, Just Eat Takeaway and its own direct ordering channel. Full-time About SOUS SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all. Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's. Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception. We are a team of 27, working from our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre, and we are growing fast across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa. About the role Our promise to restaurants is simple: SOUS helps you grow. That means more
